original_physarius.original_role: metadata-only, privacy-preserving selective data navigation, NOT SAT solving

new_SAT_adapter: The original Physarius 5D weighted ranking is applied to original-CNF pivot metadata. This is NEW ADAPTATION of Physarius source navigation, not a claim original archive code solved SAT.
eight_CNF_families: Same 8 synthetic structural families as JUXTAPOSE-R5 but 4 NEVER-USED source seeds, different original SHA, prereg before evaluation
source_manifest_rule: Source-only compute 120 SHA, commit exact full manifest and pin its Git blob before any proof scoring on those 120

five_dimensions_SAT_adaptation.D1: shape rarity from candidate parent (pos,neg,width) signature count across SAME CNF candidate pivots; rare signatures have 1/sqrt(count)
five_dimensions_SAT_adaptation.D2: cross-source-clauses width strata diversity (1,2,3,4) weighted log2(1+n)/log2(5), structurally analogous not independent biological lineage
five_dimensions_SAT_adaptation.D3: source parent pair-work anomaly relative to median/MAD of pivot candidates; RARE cheap work preferred: 1/(1+abs(work-median)/(MAD+1))
five_dimensions_SAT_adaptation.D4: deterministic adjacent pivot source-shape boundary indicator; adjacency is ordering metadata only, NOT physical adjacency/time
five_dimensions_SAT_adaptation.D5: manageable, exact-candidate-eligible and within fixed pair budget, scaled 1/(1+pair_work)
five_dimensions_SAT_adaptation.weights: use exact original 5D weights above; do not optimize on 120 prospective OOD
five_dimensions_SAT_adaptation.claim: only relative ordering of where to spend the next exact SAT proof attempt, never oracle.

fusion_score: predeclared 1/2 normalized PHYSARIUS 5D navigation score + 1/2 original trained passive JUXTAPOSE cost-aware score
training_policy: No extra proof training labels for all passive arms; active JUXTAPOSE pays additional distinct 2-label lookups. PHYSARIUS metadata-only never trained. Fusion uses same 45 training source stream and passive on-policy exact receipts, no prior holdout feedback.
success: first EXACT replay verified source-entailed XOR with positive GF2 coefficient rank delta above independent unit-propagation+XOR source extractor; no full-XOR-inventory claim
metrics: all exact root proof attempts train+test
all attempted parent clause-pair operations train+test
per-arm measured exact replay and ranking wall total train+test
holdout SHA and train SHA separation
normalization: Within each source normalize Physarius ranking score to [0,1] using source-only candidate scores. Fusion JUXTAPOSE score is Laplace posterior adjusted for proof pairwork and normalized within same source.
acceptance_gate: PHYSARIUS fusion must reduce total train+test exact probes, parent-pair work AND measured same-host source replay wall vs the best baseline independently for EACH seed, no lost proof-positive cases, replicate exactly in two CI jobs. Otherwise DEVELOPMENT_ONLY_FAIL.
science_guard: Censor unsupported proof width, no fabricated SAT results; same-admin synthetic not external blind
previous_120_used_for_design: R5 pre-observed source cohort is development baseline and NOT unseen.
